title: Pageantry in Beijing. Firebombs in Hong Kong.

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for Dealbook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日通讯《Dealbook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的Dealbook峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的人物，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zilran Mondani and many others live on stage at the Dealbook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼等许多人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 届时，你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at NYTimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在NYTimes.com上直播部分采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅用户，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天。

sentences.en: As China celebrated 70 years of Communist Party rule.
sentences.zh: 正值中国庆祝共产党执政70周年之际。

sentences.en: Scenes of pageantry, pride and unity in Beijing.
sentences.zh: 北京呈现出盛大的场面、自豪感和团结的景象。

sentences.en: With firebombs, rubber bullets and mass protests in Hong Kong.
sentences.zh: 而香港则充斥着燃烧弹、橡胶子弹和大规模抗议活动。

sentences.en: My colleague Natalie Kitchareff speaks with China correspondent Javier Hernandez about a day of historic contrasts.
sentences.zh: 我的同事娜塔莉·基查雷夫将与中国区记者哈维尔·埃尔南德斯探讨这一具有历史反差的一天。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, October 2nd.
sentences.zh: 今天是10月2日，星期三。

sentences.en: Javier, take us back to a few weeks ago when you get this knock at your door.
sentences.zh: 哈维尔，带我们回到几周前，当时你听到敲门声的时候。

sentences.en: It's Saturday morning.
sentences.zh: 那是周六早上。

sentences.en: I'm in my home in Beijing just relaxing.
sentences.zh: 我当时在北京的家里休息。

sentences.en: And I get a call from downstairs saying that there's an officer from the Beijing Police Department and he wants to discuss something with you.
sentences.zh: 楼下打来电话说，有一位北京警方的警官想找我谈谈。

sentences.en: And in that moment, I didn't really know what he wanted to talk about, whether it was an article I'd written.
sentences.zh: 那一刻，我真的不知道他想谈什么，是不是因为我写过的一篇文章。

sentences.en: You know, sometimes we get visits from the police.
sentences.zh: 你知道，有时我们确实会收到警方的来访。

sentences.en: But in this case, I really had no idea.
sentences.zh: 但在这种情况下，我真的毫无头绪。

sentences.en: And so I was racking my brain.
sentences.zh: 所以我绞尽脑汁地想。

sentences.en: And before I knew it, the knock was at my door.
sentences.zh: 还没等我反应过来，敲门声就响了。

sentences.en: And I opened it up and it was Officer Wong Young.
sentences.zh: 我打开门，是王勇警官。

sentences.en: And he was a veteran of the police department.
sentences.zh: 他是一位资深警官。

sentences.en: He had a nice smile, but also looked kind of nervous.
sentences.zh: 他带着友好的微笑，但看起来也有点紧张。

sentences.en: And he asked, do you know about the National Day celebrations?
sentences.zh: 他问我，你知道国庆庆典的事吗？

sentences.en: And do you?
sentences.zh: 你知道吗？

sentences.en: Well, as a correspondent in Beijing, yes, I did.
sentences.zh: 作为驻京记者，是的，我知道。

sentences.en: We had sort of been obsessed with the National Day preparations.
sentences.zh: 我们当时几乎沉迷于国庆的筹备工作。

sentences.en: And so it's this yearly event where China celebrates its birthday, where there's often a lot of festivities going on.
sentences.zh: 这是一个中国庆祝生日的年度盛事，通常会有很多庆祝活动。

sentences.en: But this year was the 70th anniversary of the founding of the People's Republic of China.
sentences.zh: 但今年是中华人民共和国成立70周年。

sentences.en: And so it was an extra special year.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个格外特殊的年份。

sentences.en: It was like the biggest event of the year or even the decade for the Communist Party.
sentences.zh: 这就像是共产党今年甚至这十年里最重大的活动。

sentences.en: And they were planning this huge military parade that would crown Xi Jinping as the indomitable leader of China.
sentences.zh: 他们正在策划一场盛大的阅兵式，旨在确立习近平作为中国不可动摇的领导人的地位。

sentences.en: And so it seemed like it was going to be a particularly sensitive year.
sentences.zh: 所以这看起来是一个特别敏感的年份。

sentences.en: But why is he at your door asking if you know about this celebration?
sentences.zh: 但他为什么会到你家门口问你是否知道这次庆典？

sentences.en: Well, he wanted me to leave.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他想让我离开。

sentences.en: He basically said, you have no choice.
sentences.zh: 他基本上说，你别无选择。

sentences.en: You need to leave.
sentences.zh: 你必须离开。

sentences.en: Armed police are going to be stationed inside your home for four days.
sentences.zh: 武装警察将在你家里驻守四天。

sentences.en: Whoa.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Why would the police need to take over your apartment for this parade?
sentences.zh: 为什么警方需要为了这次阅兵接管你的公寓？

sentences.en: Well, I've been asking myself that a lot lately.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我最近也一直在问自己这个问题。

sentences.en: And I don't think there's a clear answer.
sentences.zh: 我觉得没有明确的答案。

sentences.en: But I think it has to do with this obsession with security that's spread throughout China in recent years.
sentences.zh: 但我认为这与近年来在中国蔓延的对安全的痴迷有关。

sentences.en: And this fear that something could go wrong.
sentences.zh: 以及对可能出错的恐惧。

sentences.en: This is a meticulously rehearsed extravaganza.
sentences.zh: 这是一场精心排练的盛会。

sentences.en: This is something that they've planned to every detail.
sentences.zh: 这是他们计划到每一个细节的事情。

sentences.en: They've been rehearsing for months.
sentences.zh: 他们已经排练了几个月。

sentences.en: And everyone here knows that they're going to be on TV.
sentences.zh: 这里的每个人都知道他们会上电视。

sentences.en: And I think there's probably a lot of fear on that stage if anything goes wrong.
sentences.zh: 我想如果出了什么差错，舞台上的人可能会感到非常恐惧。

sentences.en: And so I think they were just being extra careful, wanted to minimize any risk, and kicked me out.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为他们只是格外小心，想尽量减少任何风险，于是把我赶走了。

sentences.en: So where do you go?
sentences.zh: 那你去哪儿了？

sentences.en: So I stayed in my apartment for a few more weeks.
sentences.zh: 我还在我的公寓里待了几周。

sentences.en: Every weekend, though, the party was having these mass rehearsals for the parade.
sentences.zh: 不过每个周末，党都会为阅兵举行大规模的排练。

sentences.en: And so they forced me to stay in my room under curfew while they held these rehearsals.
sentences.zh: 所以他们在举行这些排练时，强迫我待在房间里，实行宵禁。

sentences.en: And I was told to close my curtains promptly at 8 p.m.
sentences.zh: 我被告知必须在晚上8点准时拉上窗帘。

sentences.en: And the officer kept checking in on me to see what my plans were.
sentences.zh: 警官不断地查看我，看我有什么计划。

sentences.en: And I didn't really know.
sentences.zh: 我其实也不知道。

sentences.en: So I kind of just put him off for a while.
sentences.zh: 所以我只好先敷衍他一阵子。

sentences.en: And then eventually I had to make a decision.
sentences.zh: 最后我不得不做出决定。

sentences.en: So I decided to go to Taipei, where I have family, and watch the parade from there.
sentences.zh: 所以我决定去台北，我有家人在那里，从那里观看阅兵。

sentences.en: So it starts about 10 a.m.
sentences.zh: 阅兵大约在上午10点开始。

sentences.en: And you see thousands of soldiers come out holding the Chinese flag, many holding huge rifles.
sentences.zh: 你看到成千上万的士兵拿着中国国旗走出来，许多人拿着巨大的步枪。

sentences.en: The weapons are rolling out one by one.
sentences.zh: 武器装备一个接一个地开过。

sentences.en: We see supersonic drones.
sentences.zh: 我们看到了超音速无人机。

sentences.en: We see unmanned underwater vehicles.
sentences.zh: 我们看到了无人水下航行器。

sentences.en: There are intercontinental ballistic missiles.
sentences.zh: 还有洲际弹道导弹。

sentences.en: And here's the last equipment formation.
sentences.zh: 这是最后的装备方队。

sentences.en: It features DF-41 nuclear missiles.
sentences.zh: 展示的是东风-41核导弹。

sentences.en: The DF-41 is an intercontinental strategic nuclear missile.
sentences.zh: 东风-41是一种洲际战略核导弹。

sentences.en: Its purpose is for both balancing power and securing victory.
sentences.zh: 它的目的是平衡力量和确保胜利。

sentences.en: You see thousands of soldiers come out holding the Chinese flag.
sentences.zh: 你看到成千上万的士兵拿着中国国旗走出来。

sentences.en: And they're walking down a huge red carpet.
sentences.zh: 他们走在巨大的红地毯上。

sentences.en: These columns of soldiers dressed in white and black and green.
sentences.zh: 这些身穿白、黑、绿制服的士兵方阵。

sentences.en: And they're walking toward the center stage where Xi Jinping is preparing to make a speech.
sentences.zh: 他们正走向习近平准备发表讲话的中心舞台。

sentences.en: And what happens as Xi Jinping takes the stage?
sentences.zh: 习近平登上舞台时发生了什么？

sentences.en: Well, there's this moment where there's an incredible resounding salute throughout the entire Tiananmen Square.
sentences.zh: 嗯，那一刻整个天安门广场响起了震耳欲聋的礼炮声。

sentences.en: I think it's a 70-gun salute.
sentences.zh: 我想是70响礼炮。

sentences.en: And they welcome Xi Jinping to the stage.
sentences.zh: 他们欢迎习近平登上舞台。

sentences.en: So he walks to the microphone wearing this dark Mao suit and looking rather solemn.
sentences.zh: 他穿着深色的中山装，神情相当严肃地走向麦克风。

sentences.en: So what I'm waiting for is to hear what he has to say about Hong Kong.
sentences.zh: 我当时在等他谈论关于香港的事情。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Why is that important?
sentences.zh: 为什么那很重要？

sentences.en: Well, we're now in the 17th consecutive week of protests in Hong Kong.
sentences.zh: 因为香港的抗议活动已经持续了17周。

sentences.en: They started back in June over opposition to a bill that would have allowed extraditions to mainland China.
sentences.zh: 它们始于6月，起因是反对一项允许向中国大陆引渡的法案。

sentences.en: But since then, they've morphed and escalated into this broader fight for democracy and for civil liberties in Hong Kong.
sentences.zh: 但从那以后，抗议活动演变并升级为一场更广泛的争取香港民主和公民自由的斗争。

sentences.en: And throughout this period, there's been one voice that's been missing in all this.
sentences.zh: 在这期间，有一个声音一直缺失。

sentences.en: And that is the voice of Xi Jinping.
sentences.zh: 那就是习近平的声音。

sentences.en: And so this was a moment on this very important day where we thought Xi Jinping might finally offer more details about his thinking on Hong Kong
sentences.zh: 所以在这个非常重要的日子里，我们认为习近平可能会最终提供更多关于他对香港的看法细节，

sentences.en: or how the government might deal with this crisis.
sentences.zh: 或者政府可能会如何处理这场危机。

sentences.en: It was clear what his message was.
sentences.zh: 他的信息很明确。

sentences.en: And it was that China would not back down.
sentences.zh: 那就是中国绝不会退缩。

sentences.en: And even he himself said,
sentences.zh: 甚至他自己也说，

sentences.en: No power can stop the progress of the Chinese people and the Chinese nation.
sentences.zh: 没有任何力量能够阻挡中国人民和中华民族的前进步伐。

sentences.en: So I assume that message didn't land well with the protesters in Hong Kong.
sentences.zh: 所以我猜这个信息在香港的抗议者听来并不好受。

sentences.en: So we always knew there would be big protests on National Day in Hong Kong.
sentences.zh: 我们一直都知道香港国庆节会有大规模抗议活动。

sentences.en: But Xi Jinping's remarks seemed to add to the deep anger that a lot of protesters felt.
sentences.zh: 但习近平的讲话似乎加剧了许多抗议者内心深处的愤怒。

sentences.en: So I headed to Hong Kong to see what was happening on the ground.
sentences.zh: 所以我前往香港，看看实地发生了什么。

sentences.en: A lot of festivities lined up for the day.
sentences.zh: 今天安排了很多庆祝活动。

sentences.en: And we are really excited.
sentences.zh: 我们真的很兴奋。

sentences.en: As you see all the audience, their excitement is really infectious.
sentences.zh: 正如你所见，观众的兴奋感真的很有感染力。

sentences.en: So back to you, Zhou Ye.
sentences.zh: 现在把时间交还给你，周晔。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Thank you very much, Sun Ye, for your reporting on the Tiananmen Square.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢孙晔在天安门广场的报道。

sentences.en: And you're now watching a special coverage on the 70th anniversary of the People's Republic of China.
sentences.zh: 你现在正在收看关于中华人民共和国成立70周年的特别报道。

sentences.en: We'll be back in a minute.
sentences.zh: 我们稍后回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道你需要订阅《时报》才能获取所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果能免费试用《时报》一个月，且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在应用里的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间越过付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: So I landed in Hong Kong around 3 p.m.
sentences.zh: 我大约在下午3点降落在香港。

sentences.en: And it's kind of eerie.
sentences.zh: 感觉有点阴森。

sentences.en: It's really quiet.
sentences.zh: 非常安静。

sentences.en: And this is a week when a lot of mainlanders are on holiday.
sentences.zh: 这一周很多大陆人都在度假。

sentences.en: And they would typically come to a place like Hong Kong.
sentences.zh: 他们通常会去香港之类的地方。

sentences.en: But they're not making that trip this year for obvious reasons.
sentences.zh: 但今年由于显而易见的原因，他们没有成行。

sentences.en: And so I go and walk through this empty airport.
sentences.zh: 所以我走过这个空荡荡的机场。

sentences.en: Hey, Kevin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，凯文。

sentences.en: How's it going?
sentences.zh: 怎么样？

sentences.en: And find our bureau's tech manager, Kevin Roche.
sentences.zh: 找到了我们分社的技术经理凯文·罗奇。

sentences.en: So what do you got?
sentences.zh: 你带了什么？

sentences.en: I got the whole...
sentences.zh: 我带了全部……

sentences.en: Should we go through here?
sentences.zh: 我们要从这里走吗？

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Why don't we go over there?
sentences.zh: 我们去那边怎么样？

sentences.en: And he gives me my equipment.
sentences.zh: 他把装备给了我。

sentences.en: What's the equipment?
sentences.zh: 是什么装备？

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Let's see.
sentences.zh: 让我看看。

sentences.en: So there's...
sentences.zh: 所以有……

sentences.en: Well, he gives me a gas mask.
sentences.zh: 他给了我一个防毒面具。

sentences.en: So it just straps on in the back there?
sentences.zh: 它是从后面系上的吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, it just straps on right here.
sentences.zh: 是的，就在这里系上。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: A helmet, a first aid kit.
sentences.zh: 一个头盔，一个急救包。

sentences.en: And this is a new kind of a full face mask that we just got a few of.
sentences.zh: 这是一种新型的全脸面罩，我们刚拿到几个。

sentences.en: And a press veSt.
sentences.zh: 还有一件记者背心。

sentences.en: One of those, like, bright yellow, like, construction worker vests.
sentences.zh: 就是那种亮黄色的，像建筑工人穿的背心。

sentences.en: So I think that's everything you might need.
sentences.zh: 我想这就是你可能需要的一切了。

sentences.en: There's a bottle of water in there, too.
sentences.zh: 那里面还有一瓶水。

sentences.en: So right away, upon landing, you're preparing for this situation to become pretty dangerous.
sentences.zh: 所以一落地，你马上就会预感到局势会变得相当危险。

sentences.en: Right, so the protests have been relatively peaceful, but there have been these cases where it quickly escalates.
sentences.zh: 没错，抗议活动相对和平，但确实出现了一些迅速升级的情况。

sentences.en: And certainly that's picked up in the past couple of days.
sentences.zh: 而且在过去几天里，这种情况肯定有所增加。

sentences.en: I'm at the airport now, and I'm checking my phone and seeing a lot of messages saying that there's a pretty tense standoff in northern Hong Kong.
sentences.zh: 我现在在机场，查看手机时看到很多消息说香港北部出现了相当紧张的对峙。

sentences.en: And so I'm going to go check it out.
sentences.zh: 所以我打算去看看。

sentences.en: And so I headed out, got an Uber.
sentences.zh: 于是我出发了，叫了一辆优步。

sentences.en: Sorry, what did you say?
sentences.zh: 抱歉，你刚才说什么？

sentences.en: Be careful.
sentences.zh: 小心点。

sentences.en: Oh.
sentences.zh: 哦。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: And found my way to the protesters.
sentences.zh: 然后我找到了抗议者。

sentences.en: Bye-bye.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: And what did you see?
sentences.zh: 你看到了什么？

sentences.en: In front of me, I could see black-clad protesters.
sentences.zh: 在我面前，我能看到身穿黑衣的抗议者。

sentences.en: And they were lighting fires.
sentences.zh: 他们正在放火。

sentences.en: They were just creating chaos along this particular stretch.
sentences.zh: 他们只是在这一带制造混乱。

sentences.en: The scene is pretty chaotic.
sentences.zh: 现场相当混乱。

sentences.en: There are hundreds of protesters gathering around different stores that are believed to have a probaging stance.
sentences.zh: 有数百名抗议者聚集在一些被认为立场亲政府的商店周围。

sentences.en: And they're trying to vandalize the exterior to loot the inside and take whatever they can.
sentences.zh: 他们试图破坏外观，洗劫内部，拿走他们能拿的一切。

sentences.en: And so are you able to talk to any of them?
sentences.zh: 那你能够和他们中的任何人交谈吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 可以。

sentences.en: How old are you?
sentences.zh: 你多大了？

sentences.en: I'm 17 years old.
sentences.zh: 我17岁。

sentences.en: And are you from Hong Kong?
sentences.zh: 你是香港人吗？

sentences.en: Yes, I'm from Hong Kong.
sentences.zh: 是的，我是香港人。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: It was basically all young people, students at university and high school.
sentences.zh: 基本上都是年轻人，大学生和高中生。

sentences.en: Hong Kong people doesn't want us to become the same like mainland China.
sentences.zh: 香港人不想让我们变得和中国大陆一样。

sentences.en: And I started to talk to them just about why they had come out and how they felt about this national day and the celebrations that were going on in Beijing.
sentences.zh: 我开始和他们交谈，问他们为什么要出来，以及他们对这个国庆节和北京正在举行的庆祝活动有何感想。

sentences.en: This is a kind of like birthday for the CCP, but for us, this is not a day that was celebrating.
sentences.zh: 这算是中共的生日，但对我们来说，这不是一个值得庆祝的日子。

sentences.en: We would like to tell the world in Hong Kong we're facing a serious condition that we need the world's help.
sentences.zh: 我们想告诉世界，在香港，我们正面临严峻的状况，我们需要世界的帮助。

sentences.en: But they said Hong Kong is in crisis.
sentences.zh: 但他们说香港正处于危机之中。

sentences.en: They felt that Xi Jinping on this day should be listening more closely to their concerns and not standing in Beijing surrounded by soldiers at a military parade.
sentences.zh: 他们觉得习近平在这一天应该更仔细地倾听他们的担忧，而不是站在北京，被士兵包围在阅兵式中。

sentences.en: Are you asking any of them about the escalating violence?
sentences.zh: 你有问他们关于暴力升级的问题吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, I asked them about that.
sentences.zh: 是的，我问过他们。

sentences.en: We are not attacking everybody in the streets.
sentences.zh: 我们并没有攻击街上的每一个人。

sentences.en: We're not destroying with our purpose.
sentences.zh: 我们不是为了破坏而破坏。

sentences.en: Because we have our objective, we know what we're doing.
sentences.zh: 因为我们有目标，我们知道自己在做什么。

sentences.en: So, yes, we are like somehow doing some, destroy something, but at the same time we establish something as well.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我们确实在某种程度上做了一些破坏，但与此同时我们也建立了一些东西。

sentences.en: A lot of them seem to be not really bothered by it.
sentences.zh: 他们中的许多人似乎并不太在意这一点。

sentences.en: Actually, I don't think that's violence because all we destroy is some, maybe, public transport, which is an object, not a human being.
sentences.zh: 其实，我不认为那是暴力，因为我们摧毁的只是一些公共交通工具，那是物体，不是人。

sentences.en: So, I don't think that actually is a violence.
sentences.zh: 所以，我不认为那实际上是暴力。

sentences.en: And that is a kind of the way to express our demands.
sentences.zh: 这只是表达我们诉求的一种方式。

sentences.en: And that's a theme that we've seen repeatedly in these protests, that when it has escalated in these moments,
sentences.zh: 这是我们在这些抗议活动中反复看到的一个主题，即当局势在这些时刻升级时，

sentences.en: and when these protesters have hit the streets and destroyed subway stations and vandalized public property,
sentences.zh: 当这些抗议者走上街头，摧毁地铁站并破坏公共财产时，

sentences.en: they felt that the violence was actually necessary in order to gain the world's attention.
sentences.zh: 他们觉得暴力实际上是为了引起世界关注所必需的。

sentences.en: I just spoke with one of the young protesters who was setting fire to a subway station and breaking cameras and other things.
sentences.zh: 我刚和一名年轻的抗议者谈过，他当时正在放火烧地铁站，破坏摄像头和其他东西。

sentences.en: And I was just asking him about what he says to those people who think that violence and more extreme tactics are undermining this movement.
sentences.zh: 我问他对于那些认为暴力和更极端的策略正在削弱这场运动的人有什么想说的。

sentences.en: And his reaction was pretty much, I have to do this in order to show the police that I'm angry.
sentences.zh: 他的反应基本上是，我必须这样做才能向警察展示我很愤怒。

sentences.en: They're not going to listen otherwise.
sentences.zh: 否则他们不会听的。

sentences.en: And in the meantime, it sounds like the situation around you is escalating.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，听起来你周围的局势正在升级。

sentences.en: Yeah, so I look around.
sentences.zh: 是的，我环顾四周。

sentences.en: I'm feeling the tear gas in my eyes and on my skin.
sentences.zh: 我感觉到催泪瓦斯在我的眼睛和皮肤上。

sentences.en: And more and more protesters are lighting fires and defacing the front of buildings.
sentences.zh: 越来越多的抗议者在放火，并涂鸦建筑物外墙。

sentences.en: And then I get news on my phone that the police have shot a teenage demonstrator, an 18-year-old high school student.
sentences.zh: 然后我从手机上得到消息，警察开枪击中了一名十几岁的示威者，一名18岁的高中生。

sentences.en: And that's the first time in months of protests that a live round was used against a protester.
sentences.zh: 这是数月抗议活动中首次对抗议者使用实弹。

sentences.en: And so it's very clear to me in that moment that this is going to be big news for the protesters and might change things.
sentences.zh: 所以那一刻我非常清楚，这对抗议者来说将是一个大新闻，可能会改变局势。

sentences.en: So videos start to circulate showing the protester being shot at very close range.
sentences.zh: 视频开始流传，显示抗议者在极近距离被射击。

sentences.en: And a lot of people are posting photos supposedly showing his being shot in the left shoulder and bleeding.
sentences.zh: 很多人发布了照片，据称显示他左肩中弹流血。

sentences.en: And in these videos, he's saying his name.
sentences.zh: 在这些视频中，他报出了自己的名字。

sentences.en: At the same time, there's also videos showing the protesters attacking the police.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，也有视频显示抗议者在攻击警察。

sentences.en: And so we reach this moment where these graphic photos are being shared, clearly inflaming the protesters.
sentences.zh: 于是我们到了这样一个时刻，这些血腥的照片被分享，显然激怒了抗议者。

sentences.en: And the police are also firing back, defending their response.
sentences.zh: 警察也在反击，为他们的反应辩护。

sentences.en: So at that moment, I remember this just rush of people coming toward me and almost like a stampede.
sentences.zh: 在那一刻，我记得有一群人向我冲过来，几乎像踩踏事件一样。

sentences.en: And these protesters were running away from a crowd of about 30, 40 police officers, all holding riot gear, shields and batons.
sentences.zh: 这些抗议者正在逃离大约30到40名警察，他们都拿着防暴装备、盾牌和警棍。

sentences.en: And they were basically clearing the area.
sentences.zh: 他们基本上是在清场。

sentences.en: And so I run with the protesters and then find shelter and watch what happens from the side.
sentences.zh: 所以我跟着抗议者跑，然后找到掩体，从旁边观察发生了什么。

sentences.en: So how do you feel about that, that this young man was shot with a live bullet?
sentences.zh: 那么你对这个年轻人被实弹击中有什么感觉？

sentences.en: It's just, it's just not, it's not acceptable, you know.
sentences.zh: 这简直，这简直不，这不可接受，你知道吗。

sentences.en: People are livid.
sentences.zh: 人们非常愤怒。

sentences.en: The police, they're trying to kill them.
sentences.zh: 警察，他们想杀了他们。

sentences.en: They're not trying to solve the problem.
sentences.zh: 他们不是想解决问题。

sentences.en: They just want to beat them up.
sentences.zh: 他们只是想殴打他们。

sentences.en: They just want to, they just want to put them behind bars.
sentences.zh: 他们只是想，他们只是想把他们关进监狱。

sentences.en: They just want to kill them.
sentences.zh: 他们只是想杀了他们。

sentences.en: They tell me that the shooting of this teenager for them is a direct assault on everything that they believe in.
sentences.zh: 他们告诉我，射杀这个少年对他们来说是对他们所信仰的一切的直接攻击。

sentences.en: They are barely armed with any weapon.
sentences.zh: 他们几乎没有任何武器。

sentences.en: They just got sticks and things.
sentences.zh: 他们只有棍子之类的东西。

sentences.en: And the police got armors, they got body armors, they got guns, different kinds of guns.
sentences.zh: 而警察有盔甲，他们有防弹衣，他们有枪，各种各样的枪。

sentences.en: And they choose to rush in to shoot that student.
sentences.zh: 他们选择冲进去射击那个学生。

sentences.en: And they have, they have lots of non-level weapons like pepper spray and things.
sentences.zh: 而且他们有，他们有很多非致命武器，比如胡椒喷雾之类的。

sentences.en: He choose to use his pistol to shoot him at his cheSt.
sentences.zh: 他却选择用手枪射击他的胸部。

sentences.en: They're not trying to stop anything.
sentences.zh: 他们不是想阻止任何事情。

sentences.en: They're not trying to stop the, the, the riot from happening.
sentences.zh: 他们不是想阻止，阻止，阻止骚乱发生。

sentences.en: They are pushing them to riot.
sentences.zh: 他们是在逼他们骚乱。

sentences.en: And for a lot of them, it kind of makes them feel like they need to fight even harder.
sentences.zh: 对他们中的许多人来说，这让他们觉得需要更努力地抗争。

sentences.en: And so what I see on the ground is people rush back to the very same street where they were vandalizing and lighting fires
sentences.zh: 所以我现场看到的是，人们冲回他们刚才进行破坏和放火的同一条街道，

sentences.en: and do the exact same thing all over again, it really is this moment where you feel like the anger is unleashed
sentences.zh: 又把同样的事情重做了一遍，这确实是一个让你觉得愤怒被释放的时刻，

sentences.en: and prompting people to be much more aggressive than they ever would be.
sentences.zh: 促使人们变得比以往任何时候都更加激进。

sentences.en: Yeah, we can't, we can't give up.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们不能，我们不能放弃。

sentences.en: Javier, I'm struck that this scene in Hong Kong is such a stark contrast to the pageantry and the choreography of the parade in Beijing.
sentences.zh: 哈维尔，我感到震惊的是，香港的这一幕与北京阅兵式的盛况和编排形成了如此鲜明的对比。

sentences.en: And I wonder what you make of that.
sentences.zh: 我想知道你怎么看。

sentences.en: I think this was their parade in many ways.
sentences.zh: 我认为这在很多方面就是他们的阅兵。

sentences.en: This was the message and the image that they wanted to be seen around the world.
sentences.zh: 这是他们想要向全世界传达的信息和形象。

sentences.en: Their goal was really to overshadow whatever was happening in Beijing.
sentences.zh: 他们的目标确实是盖过北京发生的一切。

sentences.en: And in many ways, they achieved that.
sentences.zh: 在很多方面，他们做到了。

sentences.en: This was a huge embarrassment for the Communist Party.
sentences.zh: 这对共产党来说是一个巨大的尴尬。

sentences.en: It just reminded people that Hong Kong is, is chaotic, that it's not under control, that Xi Jinping's unassailable control and power is perhaps not as strong as, as it seeMs.
sentences.zh: 这提醒人们，香港是混乱的，它没有被控制住，习近平那不可动摇的控制和权力也许并不像看起来那么强大。

sentences.en: What you seem to be saying is that there was a deliberate effort by the protesters to seize the narrative here on the National Day demonstration.
sentences.zh: 你似乎是在说，抗议者在国庆示威中是有意努力夺取叙事权。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: They wanted to show the world that they control the narrative in Hong Kong.
sentences.zh: 他们想向世界展示，他们控制着香港的叙事。

sentences.en: Of course, that's a bit optimistic on their part.
sentences.zh: 当然，这在他们看来有点乐观。

sentences.en: But in this moment, they felt that the only thing they could do was to go out on the streets to create chaos and to hope that the world would watch.
sentences.zh: 但在这一刻，他们觉得唯一能做的就是走上街头制造混乱，希望世界能关注。

sentences.en: And so when I talked to a lot of these protesters, they would point to the example of the United States or other countries
sentences.zh: 所以当我与许多抗议者交谈时，他们会指出美国或其他国家的例子，

sentences.en: and saying that the most important thing is to keep the pressure on China.
sentences.zh: 并说最重要的事情是保持对中国的压力。

sentences.en: And the only way to work with China is to test China and to push China.
sentences.zh: 与中国打交道的唯一方法就是考验中国，推动中国。

sentences.en: That becoming increasingly aggressive toward China, whether it's through violence or other acts, is the only way that they can achieve their goal and sustain this movement.
sentences.zh: 变得对中国越来越激进，无论是通过暴力还是其他行为，是他们实现目标并维持这场运动的唯一途径。

sentences.en: They feel like provoking China is their only option.
sentences.zh: 他们觉得挑衅中国是他们唯一的选择。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: For a lot of them, they see this as their last opportunity to stand up to Beijing.
sentences.zh: 对他们中的许多人来说，他们认为这是他们反抗北京的最后机会。

sentences.en: And they feel like if they don't do it now, that China might attempt to destabilize and squash this movement entirely.
sentences.zh: 他们觉得如果现在不这样做，中国可能会试图破坏并彻底粉碎这场运动。

sentences.en: And so before that happens, they want to stand up to Xi Jinping, to stand up to China, and to say, we're going to fight and we're going to try to attract the world's attention
sentences.zh: 所以在这一切发生之前，他们想站出来反抗习近平，反抗中国，并说，我们要抗争，我们要努力吸引世界的关注，

sentences.en: to stop whatever might happen.
sentences.zh: 以阻止可能发生的任何事情。

sentences.en: Javier, thank you so much for staying up so late to talk to us.
sentences.zh: 哈维尔，非常感谢你熬夜和我们交谈。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: Secretary of State Mike Pompeo is pushing back against a plan by the House Democrats leading the impeachment inquiry
sentences.zh: 国务卿迈克·蓬佩奥正在抵制众议院民主党人领导的弹劾调查计划，

sentences.en: to depose five State Department officials as part of their investigation.
sentences.zh: 该计划要求五名国务院官员作为调查的一部分进行作证。

sentences.en: Pompeo called the depositions, scheduled for this week, a, quote, act of intimidation.
sentences.zh: 蓬佩奥称定于本周进行的作证是“恐吓行为”。

sentences.en: In response, the chairman of the three House committees overseeing the impeachment inquiry accused Pompeo of intimidating the witnesses to protect himself and the president.
sentences.zh: 作为回应，负责监督弹劾调查的三位众议院委员会主席指责蓬佩奥恐吓证人以保护自己和总统。

sentences.en: In a letter, the committee chairman said that blocking the depositions would constitute an obstruction of their inquiry, an act that they view as an impeachable offense itself.
sentences.zh: 在一封信中，委员会主席表示，阻止作证将构成对他们调查的妨碍，他们认为这本身就是一种可弹劾的罪行。

sentences.en: And in a closely watched case that challenged affirmative action in college admissions, a federal judge has rejected claims that Harvard
sentences.zh: 在另一起备受关注的挑战大学招生平权行动的案件中，一名联邦法官驳回了哈佛大学

sentences.en: intentionally discriminated against Asian-American applicants.
sentences.zh: 故意歧视亚裔申请人的指控。

sentences.en: The plaintiffs in the case, a group representing Asian-American students rejected by Harvard, had argued that the university's affirmative action policies
sentences.zh: 该案的原告，一个代表被哈佛拒绝的亚裔学生的团体，曾辩称大学的平权行动政策

sentences.en: had benefited Black and Hispanic students at the expense of Asians.
sentences.zh: 以牺牲亚裔为代价，使黑人和拉美裔学生受益。

sentences.en: But the judge said that while Harvard's admissions policy was, quote, not perfect, it did not violate the law.
sentences.zh: 但法官表示，虽然哈佛的招生政策“并不完美”，但它没有违反法律。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个严密控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当选举迎来了一群自称改革者的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直处于一场残酷、混乱，有时甚至是惊心动魄的斗争之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一集的《地铁》中，我和莎拉·凯尼格一起，讲述了人们试图维持影响力却在此过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《地铁》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 在任何你获取播客的地方收听。
